no_pending_body: This device reported nothing outstanding as of its last scan ({time}). That is what Windows Update and the package manager had on offer then, not a standing promise — scan again after the next update cycle.
never_scanned_body: This device has never reported a patch scan, so nothing is known about what it is missing. An empty list here means nobody has looked, not that the machine is up to date.
driver_warning_title: This list includes driver and firmware updates.
driver_warning_body: Windows Update offers those here too, and Install All will push all of them. A graphics driver is the one to watch: if the machine goes dark after the install, that is the likely cause, and a restart normally brings it back. Windows may also require a restart before a driver install can proceed at all.
